text: ビルの　なかは　ふくざつだぞ　きみに　こうりゃく　できるかな？

structure.jp: ビルの　なかは　ふくざつだぞ
structure.en: the inside of the building is complicated, I tell you

structure.jp: きみに　こうりゃく　できるかな？
structure.en: I wonder if you can conquer it?

patterns.name: 〜に〜できる
patterns.span: きみに　こうりゃく　できる
patterns.explanation: With できる, に shows the person whose ability is in doubt. きみに　こうりゃく　できる = 'you are able to conquer it'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means 'I wonder'. できるかな = 'I wonder if you can'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough manly way of pushing a point or a warning. ふくざつだぞ = 'it's complicated, I tell you'.
